title: groups_invite.py hardcodes COSE kid label 4 in invitation pre-probe
description: Found during worker6-nb3f (private _COSE_KID_LABEL consolidation). python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_invite.py:82 extracts the inviter kid from the COSE unprotected header with a hardcoded literal: kid = probe[1][4]. Same drift-risk class as the closed consolidations (tm4o, nb3f): if the COSE_KID_LABEL ever changes, this site silently diverges from lichen.crypto.schnorr48.COSE_KID_LABEL. Fix: import COSE_KID_LABEL from lichen.crypto.schnorr48 and use probe[1][COSE_KID_LABEL] (the surrounding try/except already guards malformed envelopes). Run tests/coap/test_groups_invite*.py after.
